facts.control_label: inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear
facts.doc_title: Workshop Component Removal and Load Support

setpoint.label: periodic inspection interval for lifting gear

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop

response.body: The inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear shall be provided and maintained wherever this procedure applies, and its condition shall be treated as a material unwanted event control. The periodic inspection interval for lifting gear shall be set at 3 months. This clause applies to activities archived under LIFTING-AND-SUSPENDED-LOADS at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
